messages:
Eve Black: Quick check-in 10m. We need a tiny starterkit for marketplace: single repo, modules for aws+gcp, example app, 1-page reviewer checklist. Target: prototype Thu.
Marco Diaz: I'll scaffold repo and modules pattern. Suggest `modules/core/aws` and `modules/core/gcp`.
Priya Singh: I can do docs + reviewer checklist (CIS highlights, IAM least-privileges, KMS note). Will keep it to one page.
Marco Diaz: Implementation note: keep provider switch simple. Example snippet to show in README:
```terraform
locals { cloud = var.cloud }
module "core" { source = "./modules/core/${local.cloud}" }
```
Eve Black: Good. Outputs we must expose: lb_dns, instance_count, image_used. Add minimal smoke test scripts.
BuildBot: CI tip: add tflint + tfsec, and a fast integration job that runs `examples/marketplace/deploy.sh` in a small dev account.
Legal Ops: Reminder: include `compliance-checklist.md` and a pointer to logs/audit config. We'll need that before approval.
Priya Singh: Action owners: Marco = repo + aws/gcp modules, Priya = docs + checklist, Eve = coordinate with Legal Ops & partners. Prototype Thu EOD.
Marco Diaz: OK pushing skeleton now, will post PR link here when ready. :rocket:
